context: Charge calls the payment provider once and gives up on the first error. isRetryable(err) already exists elsewhere and reports whether an error is transient (timeouts, 5xx) versus permanent (declined card, invalid request).
explanation: Safe to merge. The retry loop only retries errors isRetryable deems transient, uses select on time.After alongside ctx.Done() so a cancelled context isn't blocked waiting on the timer, and doubles the backoff each attempt instead of hammering the provider at a fixed interval. The loop is bounded at 4 attempts, so it can't retry forever.
